notes.title: Elysium v0.2.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Elysium v0.2.6 Patch Notes

Hey, survivors! We’re thrilled to bring you the latest update to Elysium. This patch focuses on exploration, navigation, and enhancing your immersion in the world. Let’s dive in!

New Features
Map System


 Introducing the long-awaited map system! Now you can visualize the world of Elysium like never before, helping you chart your path and uncover hidden secrets.

Discovery System


 Specific districts within the map can now be discovered. These districts add depth to exploration, encouraging you to journey into new and uncharted areas.

Fog of Discovery


 Explore to reveal! The map now starts shrouded in fog, which clears as you traverse the world, adding a sense of mystery to your adventure.

Navigation Marker System


 Never lose your way again! Use navigation markers to highlight key points of interest and make your exploration more efficient.


Thank you for being part of our journey as we continue to shape the world of Elysium. Share your thoughts on the new features, and remember—Elysium lives through those who dare!
-Team Artifika

notes.title: v0.2.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Elysium v0.2.5 Patch Notes
Hey, survivors! We’re excited to share the latest updates to Elysium. This patch introduces new creatures, enhanced environments, a new gameplay feature, and a sneak peek at what’s coming next. Let’s dive in!

New Creatures

 Nimblix: A swift predator that thrives in the Elysiorite mines. Beware of its speed!
 Mecha: A colossal humanoid machine, armed with orb cannons and a precision Elysiorite laser, standing as the ultimate guardian of the second LIT.

Environmental Changes (Starter Island)

 River and Waterfall: A serene yet dynamic addition, bringing life and sound to the Starter Island.
 Tree Shaders and Colors Rework: Trees have been visually enhanced for a more vibrant and immersive world.
 New Skybox with Environmental Effects: Experience breathtaking skies with richer lighting and depth.
 Dynamic Weather: Rain, sunshine, and everything in between! Weather will now change dynamically to enhance exploration.

Mechanics

 Save File Selection: You can now manage up to 5 save files, giving you more freedom to experiment and explore.
 Loot Drop:  Entities now drop loot on death.

Upcoming

 3D Map System: A new way to navigate the world of Elysium is on its way! Stay tuned for this game-changing feature.


Thank you for being part of our journey as we continue to shape the world of Elysium. Share your thoughts on the new features, and remember—Elysium lives through those who dare!

– Team Artifika

notes.title: Elysium v0.2.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey, survivors! This small update brings some fixes, visual upgrades, and a few tweaks to enhance your adventure.

Fixes


 Fixed the building preview material bug affecting all structures.
 Resolved NPC sync issues for better multiplayer gameplay.
 Fixed Rabbobo not spawning.
 Fixed walking through walls of some buildings
 Escape key functionality is now fully operational.
 Hotbar is fully operational.


Improvements


 Reworked Inventory System for smoother usability.
 Enhanced shadows and tree visuals for a more immersive world.



Thanks for sticking with us as we continue to shape Elysium. Let us know what you think, and as always, happy surviving!

- Team Artifika

notes.title: Elysium v0.2.2 Patch
notes.content:
Elysium v0.2.2 Patch Notes

New Features


 Save System & Autosave: Players can now save their progress and enjoy the convenience of autosave functionality.
 Hit Marker: A new visual feedback system when dealing damage.
 Co-op Mode: Experience the game with friends in an exciting cooperative mode.
 New Tools: Introducing the Stone Hatchet and Stone Pickaxe for resource gathering.
 New Stone Model: Updated the visuals for stones with a fresh, detailed model.
 New Island & Structures:

     [olist]
      Observatory
      Healing House
      Village
      Temple
      LIT
    [/olist]

Reworks


 Combat System: Significant improvements for a smoother and more dynamic combat experience.
 Spear: Redesigned for better handling and effectiveness. Removed spear throwing


Bug FIXES


 Network Bugs: Resolved issues causing instability in multiplayer sessions.
 Shader Flickering: Fixed visual glitches for a more seamless experience.
